div.p: This guide helps users operate the sh_active_campaign module in Odoo 18.
Quick Note: Complete API setup first, then run sync from Dashboard.
Use Sync Logs to track success/failure details after each run.

div.h3: How to Find API URL and API Key in ActiveCampaign

ul.li: Login to your ActiveCampaign account.
Go to Settings > Developer > API Access.
Copy the API URL and API Key.
Paste both values in Odoo: Active Campaign / Configuration / Settings.
Save settings, then run sync from the Dashboard.
Go to Active Campaign / Configuration / Settings.
Enter ActiveCampaign API URL and API Key company-wise.
Enable required sync options from Dashboard.
Import Contacts: Pull contacts from ActiveCampaign into Odoo Contacts.
Export Contacts: Push Odoo contacts to ActiveCampaign.
Synced contacts are identified by Active Campaign Contact ID and kanban label.
Lists: Import mailing lists from ActiveCampaign.
Tags: Import/Export contact tags.
Deals: Import/Export opportunity pipeline data.
Forms and Campaigns: Import metadata to keep Odoo aligned.
Open Active Campaign / Configuration / Sync Logs for sync results.
Review failed records and retry sync after correction.
Ensure email values are valid and unique where possible.

div.p: Important: Keep API Key secure and update it in Odoo immediately if rotated in ActiveCampaign.

ul.li: User: Read-only access to module records.
Manager: Full create, edit, and delete rights.
